content: Zendesk Agent Workspace has native dark mode, generally available in 2026, across all Suite plans (Team through Enterprise Plus) and Support plans. Admin activates via Admin Center > Workspaces > Agent tools > Agent interface ('Allow agents to turn on dark mode'); activated by default. Agents then choose Profile icon > Appearance > Dark mode / Light mode / Match system appearance, so it can flip mid-session without a page load. Coverage includes tickets and VIEWS plus Support settings pages; excludes Admin Center, help centre, in-product help panel and some notifications. Agents can independently set ticket conversations to the opposite mode from the shell. Dark mode does not change the account Brand Color. Zendesk states dark mode 'supports third-party apps and integrations' but they must be compatible. Implication for a row-tinting extension: two palettes are mandatory, tints must be derived from or blended with the host surface colour, and the extension must react to a live theme switch, not just read the theme at load. Evidence a bolt-on dark theme is not the answer: the third-party 'Zendesk Dark Mode' extension has 849 users but only 2.6/5 from 11 ratings and has not been updated since 2022.
